caseNameFull: FAUBUS, GOVERNOR OF ARKANSAS v. AARON
attorneys: Thomas Harper and Walter L. Pope for appellant in No. 458., Bruce Bennett, Attorney General of Arkansas, and Ben J. Harrison, Chief Assistant Attorney General, for appellants in No. 471., Wiley A. Branton and Thurgood Marshall for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice. Whittaker would note probable jurisdiction.
